_comment: OPTIONAL override for cc2cc's built-in policy. The MCP runs fine WITHOUT this file — these are the same values as the built-in DEFAULT_POLICY. To activate: copy to 'policy.json' in the bridge and edit. Only the sections/keys you set override the defaults (shallow per-section merge). JSON has no comments, so the '_comment' fields are inert and ignored by the loader.

teams._comment: default_admission: 'open' (anyone may join) or 'closed' (admit-only). sticky_leader keeps a leader until explicit succession.

directory._comment: active_seconds: how recently an agent must heartbeat to show 'active' in the directory. expire_days: drop from the directory after this.

relay._comment: encrypt_required: refuse plaintext over the relay. Keep true on global/relay bridges.
